verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents an AI-driven 'Talent Matching' feature (part of 'Real Talent™') that analyzes and filters applications into tiers based on risk and relevance, and the vendor maintains a dedicated 'bias-audit-statement' page, indicating some formal safeguard/compliance documentation around automated candidate screening [greenhouse-docs-11][greenhouse-docs-25]. However, the evidence pack only shows a title and one summary sentence from that page — it does not surface the actual safeguard details (e.g., audit methodology, mitigation steps, human review requirements, appeal process) that a recruiter would need to trust the automated decision. Missing for 10: detailed bias-audit findings/methodology, explicit human-in-the-loop or override policy, and independent corroboration of the safeguards' effectiveness.
